name: LKQ Prius PHV HV Isolation (XW50)
summary: This VR application is designed to support learners studying hybrid and electric vehicles. This application allows learners to gain virtual experience in conducting a high voltage isolation procedure on a Toyota Prius PHV (XW50). The app is designed as a learning aid to support learners conducting wider research and learning in this technical field. The expected audience is automotive technical colleges and technical training providers, motor vehicle workshops, garage groups and vehicle manufacturers.
